name: CT-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Six-term incumbent Jim Himes with $2.5M cash on hand
Republican challenger raised only ~$47K with no outside support
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: Himes holds a heavily Democratic Fairfield County seat, has a massive financial advantage, and faces a minimally funded challenger, while markets price his reelection near certainty. The fundamentals point to a comfortable double-digit margin with little evidence to move away from it.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Himes or an unusually strong national Republican environment could narrow the margin, though not plausibly the outcome.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jim Himes, a Democrat first elected in 2008, seeks another term in this Fairfield County district that leans about 13 points Democratic. He enters the fall with roughly $2.5 million on hand after raising nearly $1.4 million, and no outside groups are spending against him.

Republican Michael Goldstein has raised under $50,000 and lacks outside backing, and an independent candidate is also on the ballot. No public polling of the race is available, but prediction markets put Himes's chances around 97%, consistent with the district's fundamentals. The race is rated Safe Democratic.
